Method of Attack: Tricking the user into granting admin rights, then showing ads via Google Mobile Services or loading scam sites in the user's browser
Loading a blog's URL in the phone's background to increase web traffic
Attack Vector: Google Play Store via re-uploaded apps with changed names and new developer accounts
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious apps promoted as emoji keyboard additions, space cleaners, calculators, app lockers, and call recorders
URLs leading to various blogs loaded in background
Presence on Google Play Store with seemingly legitimate app names and descriptions
